meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能解析 FCS 流式细胞术文件(2.0、3.0、3.1):读取版本、事件数、通道信息与元数据,把事件数据转成 NumPy 数组,或新建 FCS 文件、导出 CSV/表格,支持多数据集文件。
howto.when: 当你给出 FCS 文件,要求读取元数据与通道、提取事件数据,或把数据写成新的 FCS 文件时触发;多数据集文件也会触发。补偿、设门等高级分析不触发(改用 FlowKit)。

say.text: 读取 sample.fcs,告诉我它的版本、事件数和通道列表。
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并汇总这些信息。

say.text: 把 sample.fcs 的事件数据导出为 CSV 表格。
say.note: Claude 会转成 DataFrame 并输出 CSV。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can parse FCS files (v2.0-3.1), read metadata and channel info, extract events as NumPy arrays, write new FCS files, export to CSV/DataFrame, and handle multi-dataset files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide an FCS file and ask to inspect metadata/channels, extract events, convert to tables, or create FCS files. It does not cover compensation, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

say_en.text: Read sample.fcs and report its version, event count, and channel list.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the file and summarize these details.

say_en.text: Export the event data from sample.fcs to a CSV table.
say_en.note: Claude will convert it to a DataFrame and output CSV.

say_en.text: Write data array with channels FSC-A, SSC-A, FL1-A into a new FCS file.
say_en.note: Claude will create an FCS 3.1 file with create_fcs.
